notes: ISIC 2019 contains the 8th class SCC (squamous cell carcinoma). SCC is NOT merged into AKIEC: it is either kept as a separate class (include_scc=True) or excluded from the shared 7-class head (include_scc=False).

warnings: 628 sample(s) carry class_index=-1 because their class is not part of the active label space; they are excluded from training but retained in the manifest.
decisions: SCC (squamous cell carcinoma) is an invasive carcinoma and is NOT merged with AKIEC (a pre-invasive actinic keratosis). It is either excluded from the shared 7-class head or trained as its own 8th class.
Every sample keeps its native label in the manifest; nothing is silently discarded. Samples outside the unified head carry unified_label_valid=False.
Metadata is used only where the dataset actually provides it (PAD-UFES-20). Missing metadata is never invented.
The final test split is never used for tuning, threshold selection or hyperparameter search.
